component: Scan Comparison modal (reached from scan history on scans/[scanId] flow)
title: The backend only computes improved/regressed COUNTS at the summary level but never attaches a per-finding changeType field to individual 'changed' entries. The frontend's badge logic is `finding.changeType === 'improved' ? 'BETTER' (green) : 'WORSE' (orange)` - since changeType is always undefined, every changed finding renders as orange 'WORSE', including ones that improved FAIL->PASS.
description: Compare two scans where 10 checks moved FAIL->PASS (real fixes) and 2 moved PASS->FAIL (real regressions) - the 'Status Changed' tab shows all 12 rows tagged 'WORSE' in orange, misrepresenting fixed issues as new problems.
affectedFiles: vibrantix-backend/src/modules/cloud-posture/scan-comparison.js:166-176 (compareRawScanFindings now sets changeType: improved|regressed|changed per entry)
tags: verified-note: Not independently re-verified (not in my spot-check sample)
fixEvidence: The old inline shape()/compareScans logic in scan.controller.js has been replaced by a dedicated scan-comparison.js module. compareRawScanFindings() (scan-comparison.js:128-238) now computes `const improved = ACTIONABLE_STATUSES.has(previousStatus) && currentStatus === 'PASS'; const regressed = previousStatus === 'PASS' && ACTIONABLE_STATUSES.has(currentStatus);` and sets `changeType: improved ? 'improved' : regressed ? 'regressed' : 'changed'` on every 'changed' entry (line 173), plus 'improved' on removed/resolved actionable findings (line 199). scan.controller.js's compareScans now just calls this module (scan.controller.js:1184). ScanComparisonModal.jsx:427-430 still reads finding.changeType for its BETTER/WORSE badge — that field is no longer ever undefined for changed findings.
